project_comments.note: Architectural gap identified during WP-002 review: CompletePipelineSchema (pipeline.ts line 234) still uses /^WP-\\d{3}$/ while StartPipelineSchema, CancelPipelineSchema, and UpdatePipelineProgressSchema now use /^WP-\\d{3,}$/. This creates a workflow break for projects with 4+ digit WP IDs — the pipeline can be started but not completed. Recommend creating a micro-WP in Phase 2 or as a prerequisite fix to update CompletePipelineSchema's regex. Low effort, high impact for safety before any project reaches WP-1000.

Confirmed during WP-003 review: src/tools/observations.ts AddObservationSchema (line 21) also still uses /^WP-\\d{3}$/ — same pre-existing gap as CompletePipelineSchema (pipeline.ts line 234). The follow-up micro-WP to fix CompletePipelineSchema should simultaneously fix AddObservationSchema. Two-line change, same file pattern. Both gaps are pre-existing and do not affect any current ledger files (all current WP IDs are 3 digits).
